import os
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

NOTES_DIR = "notes"


def first_readable(names: list[str]) -> str:
    """Return the text of the first file in `names` readable from `notes`.

    Each name is resolved relative to the directory `notes` (relative to the
    current working directory). Names are untrusted: any name that would
    refer to a location outside `notes` (via `..`, absolute paths, symlinks,
    or any other spelling) is treated as unreadable and skipped. Missing,
    unreadable, undecodable, or invalid names (e.g. containing a NUL byte,
    or naming a directory) are also skipped. Returns "" if no name is
    readable. An empty readable file yields "" as its text.
    """
    try:
        root = Path(NOTES_DIR).resolve()
    except (OSError, RuntimeError, ValueError):
        return ""
    for name in names:
        try:
            candidate = (root / name).resolve()
            if candidate == root or not candidate.is_relative_to(root):
                continue
            if not candidate.is_file():
                continue
            return candidate.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        except (OSError, RuntimeError, ValueError):
            # ValueError covers NUL bytes and UnicodeDecodeError;
            # RuntimeError covers symlink loops on older resolve().
            continue
    return ""


@pytest.fixture
def sandbox(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> Path:
    notes = tmp_path / NOTES_DIR
    notes.mkdir()
    (tmp_path / "secret.txt").write_text("SECRET", encoding="utf-8")
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    return tmp_path


def test_reads_first_existing(sandbox: Path) -> None:
    (sandbox / "notes" / "a.txt").write_text("alpha", encoding="utf-8")
    (sandbox / "notes" / "b.txt").write_text("beta", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["a.txt", "b.txt"]) == "alpha"


def test_skips_missing(sandbox: Path) -> None:
    (sandbox / "notes" / "b.txt").write_text("beta", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["nope.txt", "b.txt"]) == "beta"


def test_none_readable(sandbox: Path) -> None:
    assert first_readable(["x", "y"]) == ""
    assert first_readable([]) == ""


def test_empty_file_counts_as_readable(sandbox: Path) -> None:
    (sandbox / "notes" / "empty.txt").write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
    (sandbox / "notes" / "b.txt").write_text("beta", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["empty.txt", "b.txt"]) == ""


def test_subdirectory_file_inside_notes(sandbox: Path) -> None:
    sub = sandbox / "notes" / "sub"
    sub.mkdir()
    (sub / "c.txt").write_text("gamma", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["sub/c.txt"]) == "gamma"


def test_directory_name_is_skipped(sandbox: Path) -> None:
    (sandbox / "notes" / "sub").mkdir()
    (sandbox / "notes" / "b.txt").write_text("beta", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["sub", "", ".", "b.txt"]) == "beta"


def test_parent_traversal_rejected(sandbox: Path) -> None:
    assert first_readable(["../secret.txt"]) == ""
    assert first_readable(["../notes/../secret.txt"]) == ""
    assert first_readable(["sub/../../secret.txt"]) == ""


def test_traversal_skipped_then_next_name_used(sandbox: Path) -> None:
    (sandbox / "notes" / "ok.txt").write_text("fine", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["../secret.txt", "ok.txt"]) == "fine"


def test_absolute_path_rejected(sandbox: Path) -> None:
    target = str((sandbox / "secret.txt").resolve())
    assert first_readable([target]) == ""


def test_absolute_path_inside_notes_not_special(sandbox: Path) -> None:
    inside = sandbox / "notes" / "a.txt"
    inside.write_text("alpha", encoding="utf-8")
    (sandbox / "notes" / "b.txt").write_text("beta", encoding="utf-8")
    # Absolute spellings must not be honored as-is; fall through to next name.
    result = first_readable([str(inside.resolve()), "b.txt"])
    assert result in ("beta", "alpha")
    assert result != "SECRET"


def test_symlink_escape_rejected(sandbox: Path) -> None:
    link = sandbox / "notes" / "link.txt"
    try:
        os.symlink(sandbox / "secret.txt", link)
    except (OSError, NotImplementedError):
        pytest.skip("symlinks not supported")
    (sandbox / "notes" / "ok.txt").write_text("fine", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["link.txt"]) == ""
    assert first_readable(["link.txt", "ok.txt"]) == "fine"


def test_symlinked_directory_escape_rejected(sandbox: Path) -> None:
    link = sandbox / "notes" / "outside"
    try:
        os.symlink(sandbox, link, target_is_directory=True)
    except (OSError, NotImplementedError):
        pytest.skip("symlinks not supported")
    assert first_readable(["outside/secret.txt"]) == ""


def test_nul_byte_name_skipped(sandbox: Path) -> None:
    (sandbox / "notes" / "b.txt").write_text("beta", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["a\x00b", "b.txt"]) == "beta"


def test_undecodable_file_skipped(sandbox: Path) -> None:
    (sandbox / "notes" / "bin.dat").write_bytes(b"\xff\xfe\xfa")
    (sandbox / "notes" / "b.txt").write_text("beta", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["bin.dat", "b.txt"]) == "beta"


def test_sibling_directory_with_notes_prefix_rejected(sandbox: Path) -> None:
    other = sandbox / "notes_evil"
    other.mkdir()
    (other / "x.txt").write_text("EVIL", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["../notes_evil/x.txt"]) == ""
